categories.main_business_segments: Flexium Interconnect Inc. primarily engages in the design, development, manufacturing, and sales of flexible printed circuit boards (FPCs) and assembly of module components. Their product portfolio includes soft printed circuit boards, radio-frequency integrated circuits, automotive radar modules, AI application modules, AR/VR modules, and wearable sensor modules. The company focuses on high-frequency, high-speed transmission technologies and modular solutions for communication, computing, automotive, medical, and consumer electronics sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced roll-to-roll continuous automated production lines emphasizing high efficiency and human-machine integration. Core technologies include high-density fine line circuits, laser blind via technology, liquid crystal polymer (LCP) materials for high-frequency applications, millimeter-wave and neurocircuit FPC development, and integration of IC design with modular solutions. They also invest in optical communication, wireless charging FPC measurement, and multi-layer lamination techniques to support 5G/6G, AI, and automotive electronics.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Flexium serves major global customers in the communications, computing, consumer electronics, automotive, medical, and industrial sectors. Key end markets include smartphones, wearable devices, automotive electronics (e.g., battery management systems, cameras), AI robots, AR/VR devices, and high-speed data transmission equipment. Their products are critical components for high-frequency RF modules, smart home IoT devices, and emerging digital technologies.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates manufacturing facilities and offices in Taiwan (Kaohsiung and Taoyuan) and mainland China (Kunshan, Jiangsu Province). Its sales are predominantly export-oriented, with major markets in Asia, Europe, and the Americas. Approximately 81% of sales are to the U.S. market, 7% to the EU, and the remainder to other Asian countries and domestic Taiwan sales.
categories.supply_chain_position: Flexium operates primarily in the midstream segment of the electronics supply chain as a manufacturer of flexible printed circuit boards and modules. It sources raw materials such as copper foil substrates and protective films from upstream suppliers and supplies finished FPC products and modules downstream to OEMs and brand manufacturers in electronics and automotive industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on technological innovation, cost control, and stable operations. R&D priorities include AI transmission technology integration, high-frequency and high-speed signal transmission, optical communication, millimeter-wave FPCs, and neurocircuit solutions. Flexium is expanding into AI-related applications, automotive radar modules, AR/VR, and wearable medical devices, while also emphasizing sustainability and green energy initiatives.
categories.revenue_model: Flexium generates revenue primarily through product sales of flexible printed circuit boards and assembled modules. The company also derives income from licensing and technology solutions related to its modular product offerings. Revenue is largely transactional based on volume shipments to global electronics manufacturers and brand customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Flexium is ranked among the top five global suppliers in the flexible printed circuit board industry. It competes with other major FPC manufacturers and suppliers of high-frequency and automotive electronic components. The company differentiates itself through advanced technology, modular solutions, and strategic partnerships with world-class customers, maintaining a competitive edge in high-value and high-frequency FPC markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024 (fiscal year 113), Flexium reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$26.44 billion, a 19.2% decrease from the previous year. The company experienced a net loss of NT$816.9 million compared to a net profit in the prior year, reflecting market demand softness and competitive pressures. Despite recent declines, Flexium maintains substantial asset base and equity, with ongoing investments in R&D and capacity expansion to support future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Flexium emphasizes providing total solutions in signal transmission technology, integrating design, manufacturing, and modular assembly to meet evolving customer needs. Their products offer high-density, high-frequency, and multi-functional capabilities essential for next-generation electronics such as 5G/6G, AI, automotive radar, and wearable devices. The company’s commitment to innovation, quality assurance, and sustainability initiatives further differentiates it in the global FPC market.
